 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DR. ANSHUMAN  ORAL ORDER 8 10-01-2025 Learned Counsel for the petitioner and Learned APP for the State are present.

However, no one appears on behalf of the Opposite Party No. 2, in spite of the fact that on the previous occasion, Mr.
Sunil Singh, learned Advocate submits that he has received the vakalatnama on behalf of the Opposite Party No. 2.
2.

The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Mithanpura P.S. Case No. 545 of 2023,
lodged on 06.12.2023, under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 63/65 of the Copyright Act.
3. As per the prosecution case, the F.I.R. has been lodged against two named accused persons who are alleged to Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.36890 of 2024(8) dt.10-01-2025 have been discreetly duplicating the Tulsi Zarda product and the same was being sold by them.
4. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
Counsel further submits that the petitioner is unnecessarily being made accused in this case.

5. Learned Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submits that under the Copyright Act, the minimum fine is Rs. 50,000/- (Fifty Thousand only) and the maximum fine is Rs.
